rationale: Zone 1 set to 82% of protected-line impedance (26.39 Ω) for underreach. Zone 2 covers the line plus 55% of shortest backup line (L_BC). Zone 3 covers the line plus 120% of longest backup line (L_BD) while remaining well below load-encroachment limit (120.6 Ω). All reaches strictly increasing and delays coordinated within specified windows.
